question: When was the first edition of the Durand Cup played in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1888**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The first edition of the Durand Cup was held in 1888 in India.
 
• It is the oldest football tournament in India and the third oldest in the world.
 
• The tournament was initially organized by Sir Mortimer Durand, the then Foreign Secretary of India.
 
• It was originally held in Shimla, but later moved to various locations, including Delhi and Kolkata.
 
• The Durand Cup is named after its founder and has a rich history involving military and civilian teams.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Historical Significance**

 
 
• The Durand Cup was initially established to foster competitive spirit among the British Indian Armed Forces.
 
• It later opened up to civilian teams, making it a prestigious event in Indian football.
 
 
 
• **Format and Participants**
 
 
• The tournament has seen participation from various clubs, including those from the Indian Armed Forces, public sector institutions, and private clubs.
 
• It typically follows a knockout format, with teams competing over several rounds to win the coveted trophy.
 
 
 
• **Legacy and Influence**
 
 
• The Durand Cup has played a crucial role in the development of football in India, contributing to the sport's popularity and talent development.
 
• Many prominent Indian footballers and clubs have emerged from this tournament, making it a significant part of Indian football history.
 
 
 
• **Recent Developments**
 
 
• The tournament continues to be held annually, with efforts to modernize and increase its appeal to the younger generation.
 
• Recent editions have seen increased media coverage and sponsorship, aiming to revive its historical importance.
